description: Source code for the Editor class in Summernote, a WYSIWYG editor, managing editing commands, content manipulation, and event handling.

classes.name: Editor
classes.description: Main class managing the rich text editing functionalities, including command execution, content manipulation, event handling, and content normalization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up event bindings, initializes content, and records initial undo state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes event bindings from the editable area.

methods.name: handleKeyMap
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts based on key mappings.

methods.name: preventDefaultEditableShortCuts
methods.description: Prevents default browser shortcuts for certain key combinations.

methods.name: isLimited
methods.description: Checks if the content length limit has been reached.

methods.name: createRange
methods.description: Creates and returns a new selection range.

methods.name: saveRange
methods.description: Saves the current selection range.

methods.name: restoreRange
methods.description: Restores the last saved selection range.

methods.name: saveTarget
methods.description: Stores a target node for future operations.

methods.name: clearTarget
methods.description: Clears the stored target node.

methods.name: restoreTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the stored target node.

methods.name: currentStyle
methods.description: Returns the current style at the cursor position.

methods.name: styleFromNode
methods.description: Gets style information from a DOM node.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Performs undo operation.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Performs redo operation.

methods.name: beforeCommand
methods.description: Prepares for executing a command, triggers event.

methods.name: afterCommand
methods.description: Finalizes command execution, triggers change event.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Handles tab key press, inserts tab or navigates table cells.

methods.name: untab
methods.description: Handles shift+tab key press, navigates table cells backward.

methods.name: wrapCommand
methods.description: Wraps a function to execute between beforeCommand and afterCommand.

methods.name: insertImage
methods.description: Inserts an image from a source URL.

methods.name: insertImages
methods.description: Inserts multiple images from file objects.

methods.name: insertImagesOrCallback
methods.description: Inserts images via callback or default method.

methods.name: getSelectedText
methods.description: Returns the currently selected plain text.

methods.name: onFormatBlock
methods.description: Formats the selected block as a specified tag.

methods.name: formatPara
methods.description: Formats the current block as a paragraph.

methods.name: fontStyling
methods.description: Applies CSS styles to selected text spans.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes hyperlink from selected anchor.

methods.name: getLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the link at the cursor.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a row to the current table.

methods.name: addCol
methods.description: Adds a column to the current table.

methods.name: deleteRow
methods.description: Deletes the current table row.

methods.name: deleteCol
methods.description: Deletes the current table column.

methods.name: deleteTable
methods.description: Deletes the current table.

methods.name: resizeTo
methods.description: Resizes an image to specified dimensions, optionally maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: hasFocus
methods.description: Checks if the editable area has focus.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the editable area.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the editable content is empty.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Clears all content and resets to an empty paragraph.

methods.name: normalizeContent
methods.description: Normalizes the DOM content inside the editable area.
